objective: Classify every residual token responsible for bounded Q_DIRECT_LOCAL_NORMAL transition-congruence failure and test whether it is exactly realizable by its owner under gravity/alternating-turn column precedence.

validator.exact_isolated_schedule: Existence of a legal column-choice interleaving, ignoring wins and other residual objectives, in which the named player owns every cell of the residual while respecting gravity and alternating turns.
validator.role: validation/discovery oracle only; not adopted as Q construction rule
validator.distinction: stronger than current support-release lower-bound matching because it enforces ownership of all prerequisite column cells induced by the actual interleaving

targeted_observations: all residual symmetric differences between alternative normalized children
owner relative to side to move
falsification_rule: If a congruence-splitting residual is exactly schedule-realizable, isolated realizability alone cannot explain all representation ambiguity.
construction_firewall: Future/value labels do not enter the exact scheduling predicate; game wins/outcomes are ignored. The scheduling search is an analysis oracle, not a proposed final rank-local Q definition.
